import sys, json, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import limitharness, stress
for name, maker in (('fullbudget', None), ('clustering', stress.stress_clustering),
                    ('calibration', stress.stress_calibration), ('replay', stress.stress_replay),
                    ('replayx', stress.stress_replay_exact), ('widefilter', stress.stress_widefilter)):
    if maker is None:
        import importlib
        sys.argv = ['x', 'none']
        from fullbudget import build
        request = build()
    else:
        request = maker()
    data = json.dumps(request, separators=(',', ':')).encode()
    start = time.time()
    code, out, err = limitharness.invoke(data, timeout=200)
    print('%-12s rc=%d bytes=%d %.1fs %s' % (name, code, len(out), time.time()-start, err[-160:]))
PYEOF
